title: Common-stage descent of finitely many equations between arrows
statement: For a cofiltered affine-transition qcqs inverse system with limit c, let V_a,W_a be a finite family of finitely presented qcqs models over one stage, and let two arrows V_a→W_a over that stage agree at the limit for every a. They agree simultaneously after base change to a single later stage. Empty families are allowed. [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-affine-morphism] [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]

proof.text: Descend each equality by 01ZM(3). Refine the resulting finite wide cospan to one commuting stage. Precompose each equality by its canonical pullback comparison. The first-projection identities give the simultaneous equations.

finite families of schemes morphisms and equality descend to a common inverse limit stage; finite radicial model from universally injective limit

theorem exists_finitePresentation_equalities_stage
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i : I)
    {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] (V W : κ → Scheme.{u})
    (pV : ∀ a, V a ⟶ D.obj i) (pW : ∀ a, W a ⟶ D.obj i)
    [∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pV a)] [∀ a, QuasiCompact (pV a)]
    [∀ a, QuasiSeparated (pV a)]
    [∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pW a)] [∀ a, QuasiCompact (pW a)]
    [∀ a, QuasiSeparated (pW a)]
    (ψ χ : ∀ a, V a ⟶ W a)
    (hψ : ∀ a, ψ a ≫ pW a = pV a) (hχ : ∀ a, χ a ≫ pW a = pV a)
    (heq : ∀ a, pullback.fst (pV a) (c.π.app i) ≫ ψ a =
      pullback.fst (pV a) (c.π.app i) ≫ χ a) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), ∀ a,
      pullback.fst (pV a) (D.map f) ≫ ψ a = pullback.fst (pV a) (D.map f) ≫ χ a
